description: This file defines the Styles class used for parsing and managing style elements within XLSX files in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It handles reading font, fill, border, alignment, protection, and color styles from XML and applies them to internal style representations.

classes.name: Styles
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing and managing style XML elements in XLSX files, including font, fill, border, alignment, protection, and color styles.

methods.name: setNamespace
methods.description: Sets the XML namespace for style elements.

methods.name: setWorkbookPalette
methods.description: Sets the color palette for the workbook.

methods.name: castBool
methods.description: Converts a value to boolean, handling specific casting issues.

methods.name: getStyleAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves style attributes from a SimpleXMLElement, considering the namespace.

methods.name: setStyleXml
methods.description: Assigns the SimpleXMLElement containing style information.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Sets the theme object used for color referencing.

methods.name: setStyleBaseData
methods.description: Initializes style data, including theme, styles, and cell styles arrays.

methods.name: readFontStyle
methods.description: Reads font style details from XML into a Font object.

methods.name: readNumberFormat
methods.description: Reads and sets number format styles.

methods.name: readFillStyle
methods.description: Reads fill style (pattern or gradient) from XML into a Fill object.

methods.name: readBorderStyle
methods.description: Reads border styles from XML into a Borders object.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute value from a SimpleXMLElement, considering styling attributes.

methods.name: readBorder
methods.description: Reads individual border style and color from XML into a Border object.

methods.name: readAlignmentStyle
methods.description: Reads alignment properties from XML into an Alignment object.

methods.name: formatGeneral
methods.description: Normalizes format string, converting 'GENERAL' to internal representation.

methods.name: readStyle
methods.description: Reads and applies overall style information from XML into a Style object.

methods.name: readProtectionLocked
methods.description: Reads and applies the protection locked attribute.

methods.name: readProtectionHidden
methods.description: Reads and applies the protection hidden attribute.

methods.name: readColor
methods.description: Extracts color information from style attributes, considering theme, indexed, and RGB color specifications.

methods.name: dxfs
methods.description: Returns differential styles, reading from style XML if available.

methods.name: styles
methods.description: Returns the stored array of styles.

methods.name: getArrayItem
methods.description: Safely retrieves an item from an array with a default key.
